baseline.name: OpenSSF Open Source Project Security Baseline

controls.proposedControl: Validate and quote inputs before shell or API use
controls.verification: Inspect actual workflow at current SHA and execute a negative-input assay

controls.proposedControl: No privileged credentials or mutable production assets available to unreviewed code
controls.verification: Check job/event/token permissions and exercise a fork-PR negative control

controls.appliesWhen: code project at OSPS maturity level 2 or above
controls.proposedControl: Set the lowest default CI permission at organization/repository where supported
controls.verification: Read back enabled default workflow permissions

controls.appliesWhen: code project at OSPS maturity level 2 or above
controls.proposedControl: Run applicable automated test suite before protected merge
controls.verification: Verified actual test job AND effective required check

controls.appliesWhen: applicable project requires a coordinated disclosure policy
controls.proposedControl: Publish usable vulnerability disclosure policy and response expectations
controls.verification: Read affected repository's effective SECURITY.md and response process

controls.appliesWhen: applicable project must receive vulnerabilities privately
controls.proposedControl: Offer private vulnerability reports or a verified private contact
controls.verification: Exercise affected repo private reporting route without publishing sensitive data
Read enabled scanning/prevention controls, test non-sensitive canary

blockedOrUnknown: Private-repo Actions minutes are exhausted per original issue update; per-org quotas and runner status require authorized billing readback
Branch protections require repository administration access and are not verified by this GitHub connection
Org issue types, custom properties, Actions default permissions, security configurations, Projects and rulesets not yet verified
Local overrides must be inventoried repository-by-repository before claiming default inheritance
